name: track_shipment
description: Return carrier, tracking number, current status, estimated delivery date and the scan history for a shipment. Accepts either a shipment_id or an order_id; exactly one is required.

order_id.description: Order identifier, e.g. W00042. Resolved to that order's shipment.

error_returns.when: Neither shipment_id nor order_id was supplied.
The shipment or order does not exist. Delivery estimates are timestamps.
